objective: Prove: (1) if every range carries a proper pp-definable equivalence modulo which every circuit is functional, the law composes like cycles; hence composing like cycles is equivalent to every circuit being a Latin hypercube modulo the tops exactly when no circuit overlaps; (2) for a quasigroup, the relation of a 2x2 subsquare's four entries is functional exactly when the Reidemeister condition holds, so exactly for group isotopes; (3) the 3-net law of a finite abelian group composes like cycles exactly when the group is a p-group (its polymorphisms are the End(G)-affine maps, and a finite abelian group has a unique maximal proper fully invariant subgroup exactly when it is a p-group); record the census failures and collapses as certificates; state the Latin conjecture.
status: Proved by KNOT-IMAGES-20261021-001B-P001 (V1 prose proof with exhaustive and randomized checks; the Reidemeister closure theorem and the circuits proof's Theorem 1 cited). If every circuit is functional modulo common proper pp-definable equivalences, the law composes like cycles, so composing like cycles with no overlapping circuit is exactly having Latin circuits modulo the tops; the Latin conjecture (no overlapping) stays open. A 2x2 subsquare's relation is functional exactly for group isotopes (Reidemeister). The 3-net law of a finite abelian group composes like cycles exactly for p-groups, carrying GF(p)-representable matroids. Groups generated by the elements with u^m = 1 (without being all of them) fail: S3, D4, Z6. No ternary polymorphism of the Q8 3-net law is Mal'tsev modulo +-1 (a 416-equation certificate); with census A finding no failure there, either that law fails in larger systems or Conjecture 7 of CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001 is false.
title: Proof: functional circuits, Reidemeister and abelian 3-nets
